# Neverlose UI

Source: https://github.com/B5RLAS/Neverlose/blob/97d3dc52e60f392987284ee52dc8010b627d8d7a/NeverLose.lua

Author attribution retained in Library.lua. Local changes: remove demo; use built-in fonts; synchronise callbacks for profile application; return/set/get keybind controls including mouse binds; disconnect global input handlers on destroy; support explicit open state; size groups to contents; wrap labels and size long control rows. The application adapter also releases/restores camera mouse locking while the menu is open.
